source: Owner's market definition 2026-10-13 (re-run): the players are MEDICAL FILM MANUFACTURERS, not medical polymer / compound suppliers; 150 companies, 20 browsers; excluded segments removed entirely
market_definition: The Global Medical Films Market comprises specialized polymer-based films used in medical devices, wound care products, pharmaceutical packaging and healthcare applications. These films are manufactured using materials such as thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU), polyethylene (PE), polypropylene (PP), polyester (PET) and other medical-grade polymers. Key applications include transparent wound dressings, surgical drapes, catheter securement films, NPWT dressing films, medical device components and sterile medical packaging.
core_scope: A core player itself manufactures medical-grade polymer FILMS (TPU, PE, PP, PET or other medical-grade polymer films, by extrusion, casting, coating or lamination) and sells them under its own name for transparent wound dressings, surgical drapes and incise films, catheter securement, NPWT dressings, medical device components or sterile medical packaging -- including film and packaging groups for which medical films are one business line, and makers of film-based medical products (film dressings, drapes) who produce the film themselves.
adjacent_segments: Polymer resin, compound and masterbatch suppliers (they sell the raw material, not films)
Device, dressing or kit assemblers that only buy films from others
Film makers with no medical-grade or healthcare film products
Distributors and traders of other companies' films
Rigid medical packaging (trays, bottles, blisters of thick rigid sheet) without medical films
scope: ONLY manufacturers of medical-grade polymer FILMS sold under their own name: TPU, PE, PP, PET and other medical-grade polymer films (extruded, cast, coated or laminated) for transparent wound dressings, surgical drapes and incise films, catheter securement films, NPWT dressing films, medical device components and sterile medical packaging; film and packaging groups with a medical-film line qualify. NOT in this market: polymer resin, compound and masterbatch suppliers; assemblers that only buy films; film makers with no medical film; distributors and traders.
